summary: Canagold Resources filed a Form 6-K attaching a September 18, 2026 press release announcing a closed C$7.1 million private placement: 5,319,149 common shares at C$0.47 and 8,846,154 flow-through shares at C$0.52, for gross proceeds of C$7.1 million. Insiders participated, with Sun Valley Investments AG acquiring 6,413,462 FT shares and 3,856,383 common shares, lifting its stake from 48.25% to 49.75%. The transaction is a related-party transaction under MI 61-101, relying on valuation and minority-approval exemptions; hold period expires January 19, 2027. Watch for final TSX approval and potential creep toward control.
